packageRules.description: The pi packages are released together at one version, so they move in one pull request of their own.
oxlint-tsgolint embeds its own TypeScript compiler, so the Oxc tools and typescript move in one pull request of their own.
mise lock owns the files under .mise/locks, so the npm manager leaves the package.json there alone.
jactionlint release tags start with v and the pin in mise.toml does not.

GitHub Actions updates below a major only change CI, so a bad one fails the required checks. Majors have their own branch, so this rule covers everything on the actions branch and no manual update can join a pull request that is set to merge.
mise pins the development tools, and node here only runs them, so patch updates automerge. They have a group of their own so that no minor update can join a pull request that is set to merge.
